scope: Primary-source research only. No font downloads, builds, timings or benchmark-repository writes.
ranking_basis: Expected repeated per-glyph decoding and TrueType hint VM cost; total glyph count and file size are not per-glyph work. Screen unchanged binaries with actual mapped glyphs before choosing any confirmation font.
experiment_constraints: Keep the original Latin FemtoVG demo as a separate unchanged-text result.
Add a clearly labeled CJK-localized text workload if evaluating CJK glyphs; font substitution alone only measures the selected font's Latin subset.
Use common prose/UI glyphs as primary CJK corpus; any rare many-stroke stress glyphs must be separately labeled.
Record per-corpus glyph mapping, missing glyphs, bytecode and point/contour metrics, font asset hashes and exact original files.
Check glyf/fpgm/prep before classifying a TTF as a TrueType VM stressor. A TTF extension by itself does not establish bytecode; a CFF OTF requires a separate mechanism interpretation.
Pin font bytes without generating, subsetting, auto-hinting or modifying them.
Rank by actual hinted-outline timing at demo sizes/DPRs, together with unhinted timing, rather than stored hint bytes alone.

primary_candidates.name: Nanum Myeongjo Regular
primary_candidates.screening_reason: Highest-priority manually hinted Korean serif; serif CJK outlines plausibly add more curve/point work than Gothic. Bold and ExtraBold are natural original asset variants.
primary_candidates.verified_source_claim: Pinned Google Fonts DESCRIPTION describes screen hinting; official NAVER page https://hangeul.naver.com/think describes Nanum ClearType manual hinting. Complexity/cost remain inference, not measured facts.
primary_candidates.performance_status: unmeasured by this research agent; no cost or speedup asserted

primary_candidates.name: Nanum Gothic Regular
primary_candidates.screening_reason: High-priority manually hinted Korean sans control against Myeongjo.
primary_candidates.verified_source_claim: Pinned Google Fonts DESCRIPTION describes screen hinting. Official NAVER page https://hangeul.naver.com/think describes Nanum ClearType manual hinting.
primary_candidates.performance_status: unmeasured by this research agent; no cost or speedup asserted

primary_candidates.name: Nanum Gothic Coding Regular
primary_candidates.screening_reason: Editor-relevant manually hinted Hangul/Latin monospace; useful against Alustin Latin-like repeated UI. Do not use a Han corpus for it.
primary_candidates.verified_source_claim: Official NAVER README at https://github.com/naver/nanumfont/blob/770142018d7b23abe48a1ff9370adeac3bbbcd0e/README.md explicitly documents ClearType manual hinting, Hangul/English/Japanese support, and no Han ideographs.
primary_candidates.performance_status: unmeasured by this research agent; no cost or speedup asserted

primary_candidates.name: D2Coding Regular
primary_candidates.screening_reason: Strong additional Korean editor face derived from Nanum Barun Gothic, with Han and full Hangul coverage; plausible manual hint VM stress beyond coding font alone.
primary_candidates.verified_source_claim: Official NAVER README and release VER1.3.3 document hinting tuned 8–18pt. Release 1.3.3 is metadata-only relative to 1.3.2.
primary_candidates.performance_status: unmeasured by this research agent; no cost or speedup asserted

primary_candidates.name: Droid Sans Fallback
primary_candidates.screening_reason: Legacy shipped Android CJK outline; useful older-font control. Inspect actual CJK glyph instructions rather than assuming their presence.
primary_candidates.verified_source_claim: Pinned data/fonts/README.txt explicitly says platform fonts in this directory are Apache 2 licensed. DroidSansFallbackFull.ttf also exists beside this asset.
primary_candidates.performance_status: unmeasured by this research agent; no cost or speedup asserted

primary_candidates.name: WenQuanYi Micro Hei
primary_candidates.license: Apache 2.0 OR GPL v3 with font embedding exception
primary_candidates.screening_reason: Compact legacy CJK collection derived from Droid; index 0 Micro Hei and index 1 Mono. Composite outline decoding may dominate even if CJK instructions are absent.
primary_candidates.verified_source_claim: Pinned README version 0.2.0-beta explicitly guarantees Latin hinting, not CJK hinting; names two TTC faces and states Droid derivation. Packaging maintainer repository, not author-owned upstream; original author documentation is preserved.
primary_candidates.performance_status: unmeasured by this research agent; no cost or speedup asserted

primary_candidates.name: Noto Sans SC variable TrueType
primary_candidates.screening_reason: Modern large CJK control. Use original TrueType release rather than regenerating from CFF, and inspect actual instructions before making VM claims.
primary_candidates.verified_source_claim: Pinned official Sans/README.md lists this region-subset variable TTF format; pinned Sans/NEWS.md documents 2.004 and OFL 1.1.
primary_candidates.performance_status: unmeasured by this research agent; no cost or speedup asserted

primary_candidates.name: BabelStone Han
primary_candidates.screening_reason: Song/Ming outline-heavy CJK control, including rare many-stroke glyphs; coverage is not evidence of per-glyph cost. Hinting unverified.
primary_candidates.verified_source_claim: Author page provides this exact versioned ZIP and original unrestricted Arphic license; this was confirmed by reading author HTML metadata without downloading the font.

secondary_candidates.name: Original AR PL SungtiL GB

secondary_candidates.name: AR PL UKai / UMing derivatives
secondary_candidates.reason: UKai FONTLOG 2003-05-04 says auto-generated hints were removed. This argues against assuming it is VM-extreme merely because it is old/large; can still be an outline geometry control.
